BURHAN:v3p293/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p293/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p293/r1.claim: The المستوي pattern is a word or sequence that reads unchanged from beginning to end or from end to beginning; the author illustrates it with Qur'anic phrases.
BURHAN:v3p293/r1.anchor: وهو أن الكلمة أو الكلمات تقرأ من أولها إلى آخرها ومن آخرها إلى أولها لا يختلف لفظها ولا معناها

ITQAN:v3p249/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p249/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p249/r5.claim: A further type is a word readable the same forward and backward; the Quran’s only examples are كل في فلك and وربك فكبر.
ITQAN:v3p249/r5.anchor: ومنه نوع يسمى القلب والمقلوب المستوى وما لا يستحيل بالانعكاس وهو أن تقرأ الكلمة من آخرها إلى أولها كما تقرأ من أولها إلى آخرها

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r1.claim: The first warning directive is monotheism: because the object precedes the verb, proclaiming greatness is specified for God alone; every other claim to greatness is false.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r1.anchor: Since the object of the verb in this verse has been placed before the verb, it has resulted in specifying this declaration for God only.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r2.claim: In pagan Arabia, proclaiming God’s sole greatness provoked society, yet every prophet had to declare tawḥīd openly because it is religion’s foundation.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p36/r2.anchor: every prophet was required to openly declare it without showing any hesitation

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r9.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r9.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī says the fronted object makes the command single out the Lord for magnification and for saying God is greatest; Abū Ḥayyān notes that this depends on al-Zamakhsharī's view of fronting.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r9.anchor: وقال الزمخشري: واختص ربك بالتكبير، وهو الوصف بالكبرياء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r10.claim: The fāʾ in the command is conditional or responsive, comparable to an imperative whose second command follows from a understood prompt.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p324/r10.anchor: فالفاء هي جواب الأمر، وهذا الأمر إما مضمن معنى الشرط

THALABI:v10p243/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p243/r2.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p243/r2.claim: After this appearance, God revealed al-Muddaththir through “leave the idols”; this preceded the obligation of prayer.
THALABI:v10p243/r2.anchor: وأنزل الله سبحانه يا أيها المدثر إلى قوله سبحانه والرجز فاهجر. قبل: أن تفرض للصلاة، وهي الأوثان

DURR-FULL:v8p561/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p561/r4.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v8p561/r4.claim: The Prophet's next revelation was the opening of al-Muddaththir, after which revelation became vigorous and continuous.
DURR-FULL:v8p561/r4.anchor: فأنزل الله (يا أيها المدثر قم فأنذر وربك فكبر وثيابك فطهر والرجز فاهجر)

SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r1.claim: Fronting the object ربك and the following objects signals exclusivity for some grammarians, or gives them emphasis.
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r1.anchor: قدم المفعول وكذا ما بعده إيذانا بالاختصاص عند من يرى ذلك، أو للاهتمام به

SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari says the fronting singles out the Lord for glorification.

SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhshari takes ف as conditional: whatever comes to pass, do not stop magnifying God.
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r3.anchor: ودخلت الفاء لمعنى الشرط. كأنه قيل: وما كان فلا تدع تكبيره

SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r4.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r4.claim: The Shaykh compares the construction with زيدا فاضرب, understood as تنبه فاضرب زيدا; ف answers a command whose condition is either implicit or omitted, as debated at 2:40.
SAMIN-DURR:74:3/r4.anchor: وهو قريب مما قدره النحاة في قولك: " زيدا فاضرب " قالوا: تقديره: تنبه فاضرب زيدا

ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r4.claim: The fāʾ enters as the response to a conditional sense.
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r4.anchor: ودخلت الفاء على معنى جواب الجزاء.

ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r5.claim: Magnify your Lord by describing Him as exalted and greatest; the command means, ‘Rise and warn, and magnify your Lord.’
ZAJJAJ:v5p245/r5.anchor: المعنى قم فأنذر أي قم فكبر ربك

NASHR:v2p422/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p422/r1.speaker: صاحب الروضة
NASHR:v2p422/r1.claim: Al-Rawḍa says al-Bazzī makes takbīr from the start of al-Ḍuḥā through the end of the Qurʾān, with the wording Allāhu akbar; al-Zaynabī from Qunbul uses the same wording but begins at al-Sharḥ, and the takbīr is disconnected at the end of al-Nās.
NASHR:v2p422/r1.anchor: صاحب الروضة أن قال: روى البزي التكبير من أول

NASHR:v2p422/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p422/r2.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p422/r2.claim: The author reads al-Shāṭibī as restricting takbīr at the end of al-Nās to those who began at al-Ḍuḥā; alternatively, the wording may describe joining takbīr with al-Fātiḥa and the opening of al-Baqara.
NASHR:v2p422/r2.anchor: فتعين حمل كلام الشاطبي على تخصيص التكبير آخر الناس بمن قال

NASHR:v2p422/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p422/r3.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p422/r3.claim: Al-Hudhali's account of the remaining readers' start and end points is imprecise; for Ibn Hāshim's view it should say from the start of al-Ḍuḥā to the start of Qul aʿūdhu, not from its end.
NASHR:v2p422/r3.anchor: وأما قول الهذلي: الباقون يكبرون من خاتمة والضحى إلى أول قل أعوذ برب الناس

NASHR:v2p422/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p422/r4.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p422/r4.claim: Reports from Ibn Kathīr, Ibn Muʾmin, and al-Tajrīd indicate that takbīr continues until the Qurʾān is completed; pausing to separate a takbīr after the final sūra is not possible.
NASHR:v2p422/r4.anchor: إذا بلغ ألم نشرح كبر حتى يختم

NASHR:v2p425#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p425#2/r1.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p425#2/r1.claim: The author guesses that al-Sakhāwī's unnamed scholar was Ibn Mujāhid, based on a transmission from al-Bazzī through Mudar, Ḥāmid, and al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad.
NASHR:v2p425#2/r1.anchor: أظن هذا الذي عناه السخاوي ببعض علمائنا هو - والله أعلم - إما الإمام أبو بكر بن مجاهد

NASHR:v2p425#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p425#2/r2.speaker: أبو عمرو الداني
NASHR:v2p425#2/r2.claim: Al-Dānī transmits from al-Bazzī that al-Shāfiʿī said leaving takbīr means leaving a sunnah of the Prophet; no grading is stated.
NASHR:v2p425#2/r2.anchor: وقد تقدم ما أسنده الداني عن البزي عن الإمام الشافعي: إن تركت التكبير، فقد تركت سنة من سنن نبيك

NASHR:v2p425#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p425#2/r3.speaker: قنبل
NASHR:v2p425#2/r3.claim: Qunbul reports that Ibn al-Muqri heard Ibn al-Shahīd al-Ḥajabī, or possibly another of the Ḥajaba, making takbīr behind the Maqām during Ramadan.
NASHR:v2p425#2/r3.anchor: إلى قنبل قال: وأخبرني ابن المقري قال: سمعت ابن الشهيد الحجبي

NASHR:v2p425#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p425#2/r4.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p425#2/r4.claim: Al-Saʿīdī says Ibn Kathīr made takbīr from the end of al-Ḍuḥā to the Qurʾān's end; Qunbul's formula is Allāhu akbar, al-Bazzī's adds the tahlīl, with a pause at sūra endings and connection to the basmala.

NASHR:v2p425#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p425#2/r5.speaker: أبو الحسن علي بن أحمد النيسابوري
NASHR:v2p425#2/r5.claim: Al-Naysābūrī recommends the tahlīl-plus-takbīr formula in prayer on Ibn Kathīr's reading to avoid confusion with the bowing takbīr; he notes the practice among Meccan jurists and reciters, including al-Shāfiʿī, Sufyān, Ibn Jurayj, and Ibn Kathīr.
NASHR:v2p425#2/r5.anchor: والمستحب للمكبر في الصلاة على مذهب ابن كثير التهليل، وهو (لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر)

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r1.speaker: الزهري
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r1.claim: Al-Zuhrī says the first revelation was the opening of Sūrat al-ʿAlaq; after revelation paused, the Prophet became distressed and went repeatedly to mountain peaks, where Gabriel reassured him of his prophethood.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r1.anchor: عن معمر عن الزهري في قوله تعالى ﴿ يا أيها المدثر ﴾ قال فتر الوحي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فترة

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r2.speaker: جابر
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r2.claim: Jābir recounts that the Prophet saw the angel from Ḥirāʾ seated between heaven and earth, returned frightened to Khadīja asking to be covered, and then received the opening verses of Sūrat al-Muddaththir.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p327/r2.anchor: عن جابر قال فكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يحدث عن فترة الوحي

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r1.claim: Make God alone the object of magnification, affirming and professing His grandeur.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r1.anchor: وأخصص ربك بالتكبير وهو وصفه تعالى بالكبرياء والعظمة اعتقادا وقولا

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r2.speaker: خديجة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r2.claim: A report says that on hearing the verse the Prophet said “God is greatest”; Khadīja rejoiced and knew it was revelation because Satan would not command this.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r2.anchor: ويروى أنه لما نزل قال رسول الله صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم الله أكبر فكبرت خديجة وفرحت وأيقنت أنه الوحي

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r3.speaker: أبو هريرة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r3.claim: A report from Abū Hurayra says the verse instructed worshippers to begin prayer with takbīr; al-Ālūsī says this must be interpreted if authentic because no prayer yet existed at revelation.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r3.anchor: فقد أخرج ابن مردويه عن أبي هريرة قال قلنا يا رسول الله كيف نقول إذا دخلنا في الصلاة فأنزل الله تعالى وربك فكبر

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r4.claim: The fa is read as conditional: whatever may happen, do not cease magnifying God; as a delayed apodosis particle it does not prevent the following verb’s object from preceding it.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r4.anchor: والفاء هنا وفيما بعد لإفادة معنى الشرط فكأنه قيل وما كان أي شيء حدث فلا تدع تكبيره

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r5.claim: An alternative analysis treats the fa as inserted because speakers imagine a condition, which permits the object of the following verb to precede it.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r5.anchor: وقيل إنها دخلت في كلامهم على توهم شرط فلما لم تكن في جواب شرط محقق كانت في الحقيقة زائدة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r6.claim: Putting this command before the other clauses emphasizes takbīr and alludes to knowing God first, then declaring Him free of what is unworthy of Him.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r6.anchor: ثم إن في ذكر هذه الجملة بعد الأمر السابق

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r7.claim: One interpretation sees an allusion to first knowing God and then declaring Him transcendent from association, expressed indirectly as “I mean you, neighbor.”
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r7.anchor: وإيماء على ما قيل إلى أن المقصود الأولى من الأمر بالقيام أن يكبر ربه عز وجل وينزهه من الشرك

ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r8.claim: The early command to magnify God encourages the Prophet to warn without fearing anyone else: all creatures are under God’s control and majesty.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p116#3/r8.anchor: مسارعة لتشجيعه عليه الصلاة والسلام على الإنذار وعدم مبالاته بما سواه عز وجل حيث تضمنت الإشارة إلى أن نواصي الخلائق بيده تعالى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p264/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p264/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p264/r2.claim: Magnify the Lord above what idol worshippers say.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p264/r2.anchor: {وربك فكبر} عظمه عما يقوله عبدة الأوثان.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r10.claim: Make your Lord specifically the object of magnification, declaring Him exalted in belief and speech.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r10.anchor: وخصص ربك بالتكبير وهو وصفه بالكبرياء عقدا وقولا

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r11.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r11.claim: A report says that when this was revealed, the Prophet said 'God is greatest' and knew it was revelation; the commentator notes that Satan would not command this. No grading is stated.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r11.anchor: روي أنه لما نزل كبر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأيقن أنه الوحي

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r12.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r12.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r12.claim: The fāʾ in this and the following commands can express a condition: whatever occurs, magnify your Lord.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r12.anchor: والفاء فيه وفيما بعده لإفادة معنى الشرط وكأنه قال: وما يكن فكبر ربك

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r13.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r13.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r13.claim: Alternatively, the fāʾ marks that the first purpose of rising is to declare God above association and likeness; first know the Creator, then declare His transcendence, which the people already acknowledged.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:1-3/r13.anchor: أو الدلالة على أن المقصود الأول من الأمر بالقيام أن يكبر ربه عن الشرك والتشبيه

BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r4.claim: Because warning confronts people with what they dislike, its burdens are either neglecting the command or demanding payment; the caller's aid is to magnify the sender and avoid wages.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r4.anchor: ولما كان الإنذار يتضمن مواجهة الناس بما يكرهون

BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r5.claim: Your Lord means the one who uniquely nurtures you; rise diligently and proclaim Him alone as greatest in speech and belief.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r5.anchor: أي المربي لك خاصة { فكبر * } أي

BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r6.claim: Magnifying God entails declaring Him free of partners and everything unworthy of Him, including association, division, supplication to others, and preoccupation with anything besides Him.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r6.anchor: وذلك تنزيهه عن الشرك أول كل شيء

BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r7.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r7.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr says the surahs' openings correspond: each addresses and honors the Prophet, commanding night standing in one and rising to warn in the other.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r7.anchor: وقال الإمام أبو جعفر بن الزبير : ملاءمتها لسورة المزمل واضحة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r8.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r8.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr connects the commands to patience: al-Muzzammil says to endure what people say, and al-Muddaththir says to endure for the Lord; both follow one purpose.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p221/r8.anchor: وقال الإمام أبو جعفر بن الزبير : ملاءمتها لسورة المزمل واضحة , واستفتاح السورتين من نمط واحد

DURR-FULL:v8p324/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r5.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r5.claim: Jabir relates the Prophet's account of seeing the angel seated between heaven and earth after retreating at Hira, being terrified and asking to be covered, then receiving the opening warning through the command to be patient.
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r5.anchor: قال جابر: لا أحدثك إلا ما حدثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: جاورت بحراء فلما قضيت جواري فنوديت

DURR-FULL:v8p324/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r6.claim: In a report explicitly graded weak, Quraysh settled on calling Muhammad's message transmitted sorcery after debating labels; on hearing this, the Prophet covered his head and verses 1–7 were revealed.
DURR-FULL:v8p324/r6.anchor: بسند ضعيف عن ابن عباس أن الوليد بن المغيرة صنع لقريش طعاما فلما أكلوا قال: ما تقولون في هذا الرجل

DURR-FULL:v8p325/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r6.speaker: أبو مالك
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r6.claim: Abu Malik glosses magnifying the Lord as exalting Him.
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r6.anchor: عن أبي مالك رضي الله عنه {وربك فكبر} قال: عظم

DURR-FULL:v8p325/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r9.speaker: أبو هريرة
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r9.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that after asking the Prophet what to say on entering prayer, this verse was revealed and he ordered them to begin prayer with takbir.
DURR-FULL:v8p325/r9.anchor: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه: قلنا يا رسول الله كيف نقول إذا دخلنا في الصلاة فأنزل الله {وربك فكبر}

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r7.claim: ربك is the object of كبر, fronted before its verb to express restriction: magnify no one else, particularly the idols; this is restriction of individuals.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r7.anchor: انتصب { ربك } على المفعولية لفعل ( كبر ) قذم على عامله لإفادة الاختصاص

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r8.claim: The waw connects the command to magnify the Lord with the preceding command to rise and warn in 74:2.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r8.anchor: والواو عطفت جملة { ربك فكبر } على جملة { قم فأنذر } ( المدثر : 2 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r9.claim: The ف may signal a general omitted condition, with كبر as its answer; fronting the object prepares this construction, so the sense is magnify God in every circumstance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r9.anchor: ودخلت الفاء على ( كبر ) إيذانا بشرط محذوف يكون ( كبر ) جوابه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r10.claim: As an example of a fronted complement functioning like a condition, Ibn ʿĀshūr cites the Prophetic instruction ففيهما فجاهد about one’s parents.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r10.anchor: لأن تقديم المعمول قد ينزل منزلة الشرط كقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ( ففيهما فجاهد )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r11.speaker: ابن جني
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r11.claim: Ibn Jinni allows that the ف could be extra, as in زيدا فاضرب meaning simply strike Zayd.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p295/r11.anchor: وجوز ابن جني أن تكون الفاء زائدة قال : هو كقولك زيدا فاضرب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r1.claim: تكبير means magnifying; the form attributes the root quality to its object, metaphorically likening what is honored to something great in its class because of its superior qualities.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r1.anchor: وتكبير الرب تعظيمه ففعل ( كبر ) يفيد معنى نسبة مفعوله إلى أصل مادة اشتقاقه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r2.claim: The command means to describe the Lord with attributes of greatness: transcendence from defects, exclusive divinity, denial of offspring, and all attributes of perfection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r2.anchor: فمعنى { وربك فكبر : } صف ربك بصفات التعظيم ، وهذا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r3.claim: Magnifying God includes inward conviction and verbal glorification and instruction.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r3.anchor: ومعنى ( كبر ) : كبره في اعتقادك : وكبره بقولك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r4.claim: The command includes saying الله أكبر, which declares God greater and more exalted than every great thing; this is why the phrase opens prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r4.anchor: ويشمل هذا المعنى أن يقول : ( الله أكبر ) لأنه إذا قال هذه الكلمة أفاد وصف الله بأنه أكبر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r5.claim: Mention of magnification may signal the institution of prayer, especially beside the command to purify clothes; a report in Muslim says this preceded the prescription of prayer, which Ibn ʿĀshūr takes to mean prayer was prescribed after this surah, not the five daily prayers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r5.anchor: في ذكر التكبير إيماء إلى شرع الصلاة التي أولها التكبير وخاصة اقترانه بقوله : { وثيابك فطهر }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r6.speaker: معمر عن الزهري
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r6.claim: A report from Maʿmar via al-Zuhrī in Muslim says this occurred before prayer was prescribed; Ibn ʿĀshūr infers an early prayer distinct from the five daily prayers, since the Prophet did pray in the Sacred Mosque.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p296/r6.anchor: ووقع في رواية معمر عن الزهري عند مسلم أن قال : وذلك قبل أن تفرض الصلاة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p297/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p297/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p297/r2.claim: The command to purify follows the command to magnify the Lord because purification is prescribed for prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p297/r2.anchor: لأنه لما أمر بالصلاة أمر بالتطهر لها لأن الطهارة مشروعة للصلاة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r10.claim: To magnify the Lord means to glorify Him through worship and to spread His revealed law.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r10.anchor: وربك فكبر معناه عظمه بالعبادة وبث شرعه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r11.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r11.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that some believers asked what should begin their prayer, after which this verse was revealed.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p392#2/r11.anchor: وروي عن أبي هريرة أن بعض المؤمنين قال: بم نفتتح صلاتنا؟ فنزلت وربك فكبر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p400#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p400#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p400#2/r1.claim: Magnify your Lord above what the idol worshippers say about Him.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p400#2/r1.anchor: أي عظمه عما يقول عبدة الأوثان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r2.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r2.claim: Jabir recounts that after his retreat at Hira, the Prophet heard a call, saw something, returned to Khadijah asking to be covered and doused with cold water, and then 74:1–3 descended.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r2.anchor: فرفعت رأسي فرأيت شيئا، فأتيت خديجة فقلت: دثروني. وصبوا علي ماء باردا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r3.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r3.claim: In Muslim’s version Jabir places the angel on a throne between heaven and earth after a pause in revelation; Ibn Kathir calls this the preserved account, which proves revelation preceded this surah, and reconciles the reports by saying 74 was first after the pause.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p261#2/r3.anchor: فإذا الملك الذي جاءني بحراء قاعد على كرسي بين السماء والأرض

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r1.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r1.claim: Jabir’s account through Ahmad and the two Sahih collections says that after the pause the Prophet saw the angel, was overcome by fear, asked to be wrapped, and received 74:1–5 as revelation resumed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r1.anchor: ثم فتر الوحي عني فترة، فبينا أنا أمشي سمعت صوتا من السماء، فرفعت بصري

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that after Quraysh debated whether Muhammad was a sorcerer, soothsayer, or poet and settled on transmitted magic, the Prophet grieved and covered his head; then 74:1–7 descended.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262/r2.anchor: سمعت ابن عباس يقول: إن الوليد بن المغيرة صنع لقريش طعاما

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p262#2/r1.claim: God commands the Prophet to magnify and exalt his Lord.

JISHUMI:v10p7149/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7149/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7149/r4.claim: After al-Muzzammil's commands to pray and more, this sūra commands the Prophet to warn, beginning with himself and then people.
JISHUMI:v10p7149/r4.anchor: ولما أمر النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - في سورة (المزمل) بالصلاة وغيرها أمره في هذه السورة بالإنذار

MUQATIL:74:1-5/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r6.claim: To magnify God means to exalt him and not magnify Mecca's disbelievers in one's own mind.
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r6.anchor: يعني فعظم، ولا تعظمن كفار مكة في نفسك

MUQATIL:74:1-5/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r7.claim: The Prophet rose and proclaimed God's greatness; Khadija then proclaimed it and went out, recognizing that revelation had come to him.
MUQATIL:74:1-5/r7.anchor: فقام من مضجعه ذلك، فقال: الله أكبر كبيرا، فكبرت خديجة، وخرجت وعلمت أنه قد أوحى إليه

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r1.claim: Single out the Lord for takbir: affirm His majesty in belief and speech and exalt Him above the descriptions of idolaters and other wrongdoers.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r1.anchor: وخصص ربك بالتكبير وهو صوفه تعالى بالكبرياء اعتقادا وقولا وعظمة عما يقول فيه عبدة الأثوان

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r2.speaker: النبي عليه السلام وخديجة
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r2.claim: A report says that on revelation the Prophet declared God great, Khadija followed, rejoiced, and recognized it as revelation because Satan would not command takbir.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r2.anchor: ويروى إنه لما نزل قال رسول الله عليه السلام الله أكبر فكبرت خديجة أيضا وفرحت وأيقنت إنه الوحي

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r3.claim: Prayer's postures and forms imply limitation, so takbir belongs within prayer to declare God free of every determination, even though prayer was not yet established at the start of prophethood.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r3.anchor: ودخل فيه تبكير الصلاة وإن لم يكن في أوائل لنبوة صلاة وذلك لأن الصلاة عبارة عن أوضاع وهيئات كلها تعطي التقييد

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r4.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r4.claim: A sound report says God's face is in correspondence with the servant's face during prayer.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r4.anchor: فلزم التكبير فيها لأن وجه الله يحاذى وجه العبد حينئذ على ما ورد في الخبر الصيح

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r5.claim: One reading takes the fa as conditional: whatever happens, do not stop magnifying and describing God as supreme.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r5.anchor: والفاء لمعنى الشرط كأنه قيل ما كان أي أي شيء حدث فلا تدع تكبيره

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r6.claim: Alternatively, the fa sequences the first aim of the command to rise: glorify God, since knowing the Creator comes before declaring Him beyond what is unworthy of Him.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r6.anchor: أو للدلالة على أن المقصود الأول من الأمر بالقيام أن يبكر رب وينزهه عن الشكر فإن أول ما يجب معرفة الصانع

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r7.claim: God's majesty is intrinsic and self-subsisting, not dependent on those who magnify Him; no created act can encompass His greatness.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r7.anchor: واعلم أن كبرياءه تعالى ذاتي له قائمبنفسه لا بغيره من المكبرين فهو أكبر من أن يكبره غيره

BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r8.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r8.claim: At the Mi'raj the Prophet said he could not encompass God's praise, for God is as He praised Himself.
BURSEVI:v10p173#2/r8.anchor: ولذا قال عليه السلام ليلة المعراج لا أحصى ثناء عليك أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك

NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r1.claim: Make your Lord uniquely great: no one else should loom large in your eyes; say “God is greater” whenever anything other than God confronts you.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r1.anchor: واختص ربك بالتكبير وهو التعظيم أي لا يكبر في عينك غيره وقل عندما يعروك من غير الله أكبر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r2.claim: When this verse came down, the Prophet said “God is greater”; Khadīja rejoiced, recognizing revelation.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r2.anchor: وروى أنه لما نزل قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الله أكبر فكبرت خديجة وفرحت وأيقنت أنه الوحي

NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r3.claim: The command may refer specifically to the opening takbīr of prayer.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r4.claim: The fāʾ has a conditional sense: whatever happens, do not neglect magnifying God.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p294#2/r4.anchor: ودخلت الفاء بمعنى الشرط كانه قيل وما كان فلا تدع تكبيره

QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r4.claim: In Jabir's report in Sahih Muslim, during a pause in revelation the Prophet heard a voice, saw the angel from Hira seated between heaven and earth, returned frightened asking to be wrapped, and then received the opening commands of the surah; Tirmidhi also transmits it and calls it hasan sahih.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r4.anchor: في صحيح مسلم عن جابر بن عبد الله وكان من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يحدث قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r5.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r5.claim: In a second report, Jabir identifies al-Muddaththir as the first revelation, rather than Iqra: after a month at Hira the Prophet heard a call, saw Gabriel, became afraid, went to Khadija, and received the opening verses; Bukhari's version adds 74:6.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:1-4/r5.anchor: فقال جابر: أحدثكم ما حدثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم،

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r7.claim: The Lord is the Prophet's master, owner, and governor of his affairs; he is to magnify Him as greater than having a consort or child.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r7.anchor: أي سيدك ومالكك ومصلح أمرك فعظم، وصفه بأنه أكبر من أن يكون له صاحبة أو ولد.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r8.claim: After people asked how to begin prayer, this verse was revealed to instruct them to declare God the Greatest.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r8.anchor: وفي حديث أنهم قالوا: بم تفتتح الصلاة؟ فنزلت: { وربك فكبر } أي وصفه بأنه أكبر.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r9.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r9.claim: Ibn al-Arabi says the verse calls for magnification, sanctification, and transcendence: abandon idols, worship God alone, attribute every act and blessing to Him; he applies this to the Prophetic formula beginning prayer with takbir and ending it with taslim.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r9.anchor: قال ابن العربي: وهذا القول وإن كان يقتضي بعمومه تكبير الصلاة، فإنه مراد به التكبير والتقديس والتنزيه،

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r10.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r10.claim: At Uhud, when Abu Sufyan cried “Exalt Hubal,” the Prophet told his companions to answer, “God is higher and more majestic.”
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r10.anchor: أن أبا سفيان قال يوم أحد: اعل هبل فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قولوا الله أعلى وأجل»

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r11.claim: By religious convention, “Allahu akbar” became the formula for magnification throughout worship, including the call to prayer, prayer, remembrance, and God's name at sacrifice, declaring ritual offerings free of association.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r11.anchor: وقد صار هذا اللفظ بعرف الشرع في تكبير العبادات كلها أذانا وصلاة وذكرا بقوله:

QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r12.claim: The author notes that al-Baqara discusses Allahu akbar as the prayer formula transmitted from the Prophet, and tafsir says the Prophet stood and said it when this verse was revealed.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:2-3/r12.anchor: قلت: قد تقدم في أول سورة «البقرة» أن هذا اللفظ «الله أكبر» هو المتعبد به في الصلاة،

QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r1.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r1.claim: Al-Qushayri reports that Khadija made takbir and recognized that the revelation came from God.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r1.anchor: فكبرت خديجة، وعلمت أنه الوحي من الله تعالى ذكره القشيري.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r2.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r2.claim: Al-Zajjaj says the fāʾ in both “then warn” and “then magnify your Lord” gives the sense of the consequence: rise and warn; rise and magnify your Lord.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r2.anchor: الفاء في قوله تعالى: { وربك فكبر } دخلت على معنى جواب الجزاء كما دلت في «فأنذر»

QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r3.speaker: ابن جني
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r3.claim: Ibn Jinni calls the fāʾ extra, as in “Zaydan faḍrib,” meaning simply “strike Zaydan.”
QURTUBI-FULL:74:3-4/r3.anchor: وقال ابن جني: هو كقولك زيدا فاضرب أي زيدا اضرب، فالفاء زئداة.

QASHANI:74:1-6/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:74:1-6/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:74:1-6/r4.claim: If anything is magnified, reserve all magnification for the Lord.
QASHANI:74:1-6/r4.anchor: إن كنت تكبر شيئا وتعظم قدره فخصص ربك بالتعظيم والتكبير

QASHANI:74:1-6/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:74:1-6/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:74:1-6/r5.claim: Witnessing God’s grandeur makes everything besides Him small in the heart and insignificant to the eye.
QASHANI:74:1-6/r5.anchor: لا يعظم في عينك غيره ويصغر في قلبك كل ما سواه بمشاهدة كبريائه

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r1.speaker: الكلبي
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r1.claim: Al-Kalbi takes the command to mean exalting the Lord above what idol worshippers say.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r1.anchor: قال الكلبي : عظم ربك / مما يقوله عبدة الأوثان

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r2.speaker: مقاتل
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r2.claim: Muqatil says the command is to say “God is greatest”; a report adds that the Prophet said it when the verse came, and Khadija rejoiced and recognized revelation.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r2.anchor: قال مقاتل : هو أن يقول : الله أكبر ، روى أنه

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r3.claim: The command may mean saying the takbir in prayer; although obligatory prayer had not yet been instituted, the Prophet could have had voluntary prayers.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r3.anchor: المراد منه التكبير في الصلوات ، فإن قيل : هذه السورة نزلت

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r4.claim: After “arise and warn,” the command may mean declaring the Lord above idle talk and frivolity.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r4.anchor: لما قيل له : { قم فأنذر } قيل بعد ذلك : { وربك فكبر } عن اللغو والعبث

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r5.claim: The warning is to exalt God above partners, opposites, equals, and likeness to contingent created things; knowing and declaring God's transcendence precedes other calls.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r5.anchor: أن يكبر ربه عن الشركاء والأضداد والأنداد ومشابهة الممكنات والمحدثات

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r6.speaker: أبو الفتح الموصلي
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r6.claim: Abu al-Fath al-Mawsili treats the fāʾ as extra, as in “Zayd, then strike” meaning simply “strike Zayd.”
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r6.anchor: قال أبو الفتح الموصلي : يقال : زيدا فاضرب ، وعمرا فاشكر

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r7.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r7.claim: Al-Zajjaj says the fāʾ conveys a consequence: rise and therefore magnify your Lord, and the following commands work similarly.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r7.anchor: قال الزجاج : دخلت الفاء لإفادة معنى الجزائية ، والمعنى : قم فكبر

RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r8.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r8.claim: The Kashshaf author reads the fāʾ conditionally: whatever happens, do not cease magnifying God.
RAZI-FULL:v30p168#3/r8.anchor: قال صاحب ( الكشاف ) : الفاء لإفادة معنى الشرط ، والتقدير : وأي شيء

SULAMI:v2p358#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r1.speaker: الجريري
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r1.claim: Al-Jurayrī says to magnify the Magnificent while recognizing that His greatness can never be fully encompassed.
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r1.anchor: قال الجريري : كبر الكبير واعلم انك لا تنال كنه كبريائه

SULAMI:v2p358#2/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r3.claim: Al-Ḥasan says to exalt God beyond any need for one's preaching; He answers the call of one already destined for guidance.
SULAMI:v2p358#2/r3.anchor: وقال الحسن : عظم قدره عن احتياجه إليك في الدعوة إليه فإن إجابة دعوتك ممن سبقت له الهداية

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r3.claim: Magnify the Lord inwardly and outwardly, in belief, deed, speech, and action: nothing equals, surpasses, resists, diminishes, or bounds Him.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r3.anchor: أي أنسب ربك إلى الكبرياء والعظمة اعتقادا وعملا قولا وفعلا

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r4.speaker: أئمة أهل البيت
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r4.claim: The Imams of the Prophet's family explain takbir as declaring God too great to be described, even by the descriptions used of Him.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r4.anchor: ولذا ورد عن أئمة أهل البيت عليهم السلام أن معنى التكبير الله أكبر من أن يوصف

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r5.claim: Takbir expresses the Islamic monotheism that surpasses other revealed traditions: God exceeds every description, including the description of being greater.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r5.anchor: وهذا هو المناسب للتوحيد الإسلامي الذي يفوق ما نجده من معنى التوحيد في سائر الشرائع السماوية

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r6.claim: Tasbih negates deficient, privative attributes such as death, incapacity, and ignorance; Allahu akbar is absolute transcendence of every positive or negative description.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r6.anchor: فسبحان الله تنزيه له تعالى عن كل وصف عدمي مبني على النقص كالموت والعجز والجهل

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r7.claim: Every concept is bounded and limited to itself, while God cannot be encompassed by a limit.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r7.anchor: كل مفهوم محدود في نفسه لا يتعدى إلى غيره من المفاهيم وهو تعالى لا يحيط به حد

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r8.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r8.claim: Another interpretation takes the command as saying takbir in prayer.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r8.anchor: وقيل المراد الأمر بالتكبير في الصلاة

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r9.claim: Calling Him your Lord subtly suggests that His oneness was then particular to the Prophet.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r9.anchor: والتعبير عنه تعالى بربك لا يخلو من إشعار بأن توحيده تعالى يومئذ كان يختص به

TABATABAI:74:3-4/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r10.speaker: الزمخشري
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r10.claim: Al-Zamakhshari reads the fa as conditional: whatever the situation, do not neglect magnifying God.
TABATABAI:74:3-4/r10.anchor: ودخلت الفاء لمعنى الشرط كأنه قيل وما كان فلا تدع تكبيره

TABATABAI:74:3-6/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r1.claim: On the literal reading, 74:4 calls for cleansing clothes of impurity for prayer; al-Tabataba'i reads 74:3 as prayer's opening takbir, so both verses establish prayer alongside preaching.
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r1.anchor: الأقرب على هذا أن يجعل قوله { وربك فكبر } إشارة إلى تكبير الصلاة

TABATABAI:74:3-6/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r2.claim: The five daily prayers in their present form were prescribed at the Night Journey, initially ten units and later increased by seven; prayer in principle existed from the mission's earliest period.
TABATABAI:74:3-6/r2.anchor: أصل الصلاة كان منذ أوائل البعثة كما يشهد به ذكرها في هذه السورة وسورتي العلق والمزمل، ويدل عليه الروايات

TABATABAI:74:1-7/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r1.speaker: جابر
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r1.claim: Jabir reports that after a stay at Hira he saw the angel seated between heaven and earth, was terrified and asked to be covered, after which 74:1–5 was revealed.
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r1.anchor: قال جابر لا أحدثك إلا ما حدثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

TABATABAI:74:1-7/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r3.speaker: أبو هريرة
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r3.claim: Ibn Mardawayh transmits from Abu Hurayra that, when people asked what to say upon entering prayer, God revealed 74:3 and the Prophet ordered them to begin prayer with takbir.
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r3.anchor: أخرج ابن مردويه عن أبي هريرة قلنا يا رسول الله كيف نقول إذا دخلنا في الصلاة

TABATABAI:74:1-7/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r4.claim: He questions the report's chronology: Abu Hurayra accepted Islam long after the Hijra, while the surah dates from the mission's earliest period, raising the question of where he or the Companions were then.
TABATABAI:74:1-7/r4.anchor: فأبو هريرة ممن آمن بعد الهجرة بكثير والسورة مما نزل في أول البعثة

TABRISI:74:1-10/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:1-10/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:1-10/r5.claim: Magnify your Lord by exalting Him and declaring Him above anything unbefitting.
TABRISI:74:1-10/r5.anchor: أي عظمه ونزهه عما لا يليق به

TABRISI:74:1-10/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:1-10/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:1-10/r6.claim: Another interpretation is to say Allāhu akbar in prayer.
TABRISI:74:1-10/r6.anchor: كبره في الصلاة فقل الله أكبر

THALABI:v10p67#3/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p67#3/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
THALABI:v10p67#3/r2.claim: The Prophet says that after a month’s retreat at Ḥirāʾ, he descended into the valley, saw a being in the air above him, became frightened, asked to be wrapped, and then these verses were revealed.
THALABI:v10p67#3/r2.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إني جاورت بحراء شهرا فلما قضت جواري

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:1-5/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:1-5/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:1-5/r3.claim: Magnifying the Lord means describing Him as exalted.

ELMALILI:74:1-4/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r8.claim: Magnifying the Lord means recognizing in the heart, and proclaiming in word and deed, that greatness belongs to Him alone and all else is small and low.
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r8.anchor: ve Rabbini artık büyükle büyüklük ancak O’nun şânı olduğunu ve O’na karşı her şeyin küçük ve hakir bulunduğunu kalben tanıdığın gibi kavlen ve fiilen de anlat, ilan et.

ELMALILI:74:1-4/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r9.speaker: Resûlullah ve Hazret-i Hatice
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r9.claim: A report says that when the verse was revealed, the Prophet said Allahu Akbar; Khadija also proclaimed God's greatness, rejoiced, and became certain it was revelation.
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r9.anchor: bu nâzil olunca Resûlullah “Allahu Ekber” demiş, Hazret-i Hatice de tekbir almış, sevinmiş ve onun vahiy olduğuna yakīn hâsıl etmişti.

ELMALILI:74:1-4/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r10.claim: Putting your Lord first signals restriction: magnify only your Lord, and do not leave this duty of proclaiming His greatness for any reason or event.

ELMALILI:74:1-4/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r11.claim: The fa connects the command as a consequence of a condition, making what follows depend on what precedes.
ELMALILI:74:1-4/r11.anchor: Fâ bir şarta cezâ mânası ile mâba‘dinin mâkabline terettübünü müfid olarak

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:1/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:1/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:1/r4.claim: Magnifying the Lord establishes faith in God's oneness and worship of Him, the central principle of monotheism.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:1/r4.anchor: “Allah’ın birliğine iman ve O’na kulluk” esasını ortaya koymaktadır.

WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p446/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p446/r1.speaker: جابر
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p446/r1.claim: Jabir reports that after a month of retreat at Hira, Muhammad heard a call in the valley and saw Gabriel above him, asked to be covered, and then received verses 1–4; Muslim transmits the report.
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p446/r1.anchor: عن جابر قال: حدثنا رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - فقال: "جاورت بحراء شهرا فلما قضيت جواري نزلت

QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r8.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r8.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r8.claim: Magnify the Lord above every demand, connection or separation, cause, or created thing.
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r8.anchor: كبره عن كل طلب ، ووصل وفصل ، وعلة وخلق

NAHHAS:v5p65/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p65/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p65/r6.claim: Magnify God by worshipping Him alone; the phrase is accusative under كبّر.
NAHHAS:v5p65/r6.anchor: أي عظمه بعبادته وحده وهو نصب بكبر

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.claim: Al-Muddaththir is the counterpart of the preceding al-Muzzammil; their central themes are essentially the same and their names share a meaning.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.anchor: There is no essential difference between the central themes of both sūrahs .

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r5.claim: Verses 1–10 direct the Prophet to prepare for warning about the Hereafter, exalt God, purify himself from what tarnishes the heart and from polytheism, and persevere; God will spread Islam's call.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r5.anchor: The Prophet (sws) is directed to discharge his mission of warning people about the Hereafter with full preparation
